media_ready_reference.name: media_ready_reference
media_ready_reference.value: "media_assets"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("media_assets"."cloudinary_public_id" IS NOT NULL AND "media_assets"."secure_url" IS NOT NULL)

public.appointment_details.definition: select a.*, p.name, coalesce(p.phone, '') as phone, c.id as customer_id from appointments a join people p on p.id = a.person_id left join customers c on c.person_id = a.person_id
public.appointment_details.name: appointment_details

public.customer_details.definition: select c.*, p.name, coalesce(p.phone, '') as phone, p.alt_phone, p.email, p.address, p.birth_date, p.gender from customers c join people p on p.id = c.person_id
public.customer_details.name: customer_details

public.expense_details.definition: select e.*, p.name as entered_by from expenses e left join users u on u.id = e.actor_id left join people p on p.id = u.person_id where e.is_active
public.expense_details.name: expense_details

public.fabric_details.definition: select f.*, coalesce((select sum(m.qty_delta) from stock_movements m where m.fabric_id = f.id), 0)::numeric(12,2) as stock_qty from fabrics f
public.fabric_details.name: fabric_details

public.garment_details.definition: select g.*, v.measurement_schema, v.style_schema, v.version as schema_version from garment_types g join garment_schema_versions v on v.id = g.active_schema_version_id
public.garment_details.name: garment_details

public.profile_details.definition:
select m.*, coalesce(nullif(m.alias, ''), case when m.relation = 'self' then 'নিজে' else p.name end) as display_name,
  p.gender, p.birth_date, p.body_notes from measurement_profiles m join people p on p.id = m.person_id
public.profile_details.name: profile_details

public.measurement_details.definition:
select m.*, s.garment_type_id, s.version as schema_version, (m.verified_at is not null) as verified, m.created_at as updated_at,
  not exists (select 1 from measurement_sets newer join garment_schema_versions ns on ns.id = newer.garment_schema_version_id
    where newer.profile_id = m.profile_id and ns.garment_type_id = s.garment_type_id and newer.version > m.version) as is_current
  from measurement_sets m join garment_schema_versions s on s.id = m.garment_schema_version_id
public.measurement_details.name: measurement_details

public.order_event_details.definition: select h.*, p.name as changed_by from order_status_history h left join users u on u.id = h.actor_id left join people p on p.id = u.person_id
public.order_event_details.name: order_event_details

public.order_summaries.definition:
select o.*, line.subtotal, greatest(line.subtotal - o.discount, 0)::numeric(12,2) as total, ledger.paid_amount,
  (greatest(line.subtotal - o.discount, 0) - ledger.paid_amount)::numeric(12,2) as due_amount from orders o
  cross join lateral (select coalesce(sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 0)::numeric(12,2) as subtotal from order_items i where i.order_id = o.id) line
  cross join lateral (select coalesce(sum(case when p.reversal_of_id is null then p.amount else -p.amount end), 0)::numeric(12,2) as paid_amount from payments p where p.order_id = o.id) ledger
public.order_summaries.name: order_summaries

public.payment_details.definition:
select entry.*, o.customer_id, p.name as received_by, entry.reversal_of_id as reversed_off from payments entry join orders o on o.id = entry.order_id
  left join users u on u.id = entry.received_by_user_id left join people p on p.id = u.person_id
public.payment_details.name: payment_details

public.task_details.definition: select t.*, r.stage, coalesce(t.piece_rate_override, r.piece_rate) as piece_rate from tasks t join garment_stage_rates r on r.id = t.rate_version_id
public.task_details.name: task_details

public.user_details.definition: select u.*, p.name, coalesce(p.phone, '') as phone, p.email from users u join people p on p.id = u.person_id
public.user_details.name: user_details

public.worker_details.definition: select w.*, p.name, p.phone, u.id as user_id from workers w join people p on p.id = w.person_id left join users u on u.person_id = w.person_id
public.worker_details.name: worker_details
